query.description: Optional. Set 1 to return only unread notifications

request.description:
List all notifications for the authenticated user, newest first. Pass `?unread=1` to filter unread only. Returns paginated results with `unread_count` in metadata for badge updates.

**Notification types:** `reservation_created`, `reservation_approved`, `reservation_rejected`, `reservation_cancelled`, `reservation_completed`
